Auth surface is touched, warranting a bump from S to M. Existing patterns (invalidate_user_from_cache, remove_project, _sync_project_budget_member_removed) are well-established; null-creator legacy path is covered by a null guard and its own test.

Change is confined to a single service method (delete_project) in project_service.py plus its corresponding test class. All dependencies invoked (user_project_repository, ProjectAssignmentService, invalidate_user_from_cache) are existing utilities called in a new conditional code path — no new components introduced.
